scenario: LUNI.4.5 + LIMP.4.2 — a unit symbol brought in via `from <lib> import <symbol>` is accepted as a formula param/return type reference. Pin: importing a symbol (not just a dimension) lets `unit formula`'s function lines reference it cleanly.
rules_ds:
from sub import Hz

unit dimension frequency  storage float64  base local_Hz
unit local_Hz: frequency

unit formula foo:
    fwd(x: local_Hz): Hz  = x
    bwd(x: Hz): local_Hz  = x

libraries.sub:
unit dimension frequency  storage float64  base Hz
unit Hz: frequency
